name: (BERSERK) Encounter with the Skull Knight
description: You find yourself on a wasteland surrounded by darkness and debris of an ancient castle. In the distance you hear heavy breathing and the clanging of metal — before you appears the Skull Knight, a warrior in armor radiating dark power. His magical attacks and cavalry charge threaten your life. Prepare for an epic battle with this legendary being, relying on strength and wits in this ruined world.
